sections.content: The imperfecto describes repeated or habitual actions in the past. Expressions such as *antes*, normalmente, *todos* los domingos and de *pequeños* often signal a habit rather than one completed event.

items.spanish: Cuando éramos pequeños, solíamos reunirnos en casa de nuestros abuelos.
items.english: When we were children, we used to get together at our grandparents' house.

items.spanish: Antes discutíamos por cosas pequeñas, pero después hablábamos y nos reíamos.
items.english: We used to argue about small things, but afterwards we would talk and laugh.

items.spanish: Todos los veranos visitábamos a nuestros vecinos, que vivían cerca.
items.english: Every summer we used to visit our neighbours, who lived nearby.

items.spanish: De adolescentes, confiábamos más en nuestros amigos que en nuestros padres.
items.english: As teenagers, we trusted our friends more than our parents.

sections.content: The imperfecto presents the habit from inside the repeated period. Do not automatically use the indefinido simply because the action happened in the past.
